tone.title: Full Rig Peavey 5150 + Mesa 4x12
tone.description:
5 Full Rig captures based on my Peavey 5150 (red channel):

1 - Peavey 5150 + Mesa OS 4x12 V30 with SM57
2 - Peavey 5150 + MXR Wylde OD + Mesa OS 4x12 V30 with SM57
3 - Peavey 5150 + MXR Wylde OD + Mesa OS 4x12 V30 with SM58
4 - Peavey 5150 + Maxon OD808 + Mesa OS 4x12 V30 with SM57
5 - Peavey 5150 + Maxon OD808 + Mesa OS 4x12 V30 with SM58

Slightly EQ'd for palm muting.
